name: PR Overview shows the derived INTENT card, populated from the seeded derivation
description: Walks the read-only half of L03 on seeded data: from the PR list into PR #482, whose Overview tab (the default, so no tab click is needed) renders the IntentCard above the description. The card is populated from the `pr_intent` row `seedPrIntent` writes, so this flow makes NO model call — which is the only reason it can exist at all: the classifier is a paid round-trip, and a browser suite that triggered one would stop being deterministic. What the flow is for is the wiring nothing else covers: that `OverviewTab` really is the container that fetches `GET /pulls/:id/intent`, that the response reaches `IntentCard`, and that every region of the card paints — the intent sentence, the two scope columns, the risk areas, and the derived confidence. Three assertions carry more than their length. The confidence ('45%') is the DERIVED figure, not the model's self-report, and it is the number a user reads to decide whether to trust the scope columns above it. 'Missing context' is the product claim of the whole feature — an intent derived from a description with no ticket and no spec must SAY so rather than look complete. The `sources` audit trail is deliberately NOT on the card and so is not asserted: it is still derived, stored and logged (it is what `confidence` is computed from), it is simply not what a reader of a pull request needs to see. And the cited path under an opened risk chip (`src/api/public/webhooks.ts`) is what the grounding gate promises: every `file_refs` entry is checked against the PR's real changed-file list, and an invented one is dropped before it is ever stored. Deliberately NOT asserted: the Re-derive button (pressing it fires a live, billed classifier call from the browser suite — that path is covered by `server/test/intent.it.test.ts`); the stale-head-SHA note and the failed/partial states (the seeded row is fresh and 'ok'); and every NEGATIVE case, including the risk block's — no section when the list is empty, a second chip closing the first, an unknown kind falling back to a neutral icon. This harness has only positive locators, so 'X is absent' is not expressible here; those belong to `IntentCard.test.tsx` and `RiskAreas.test.tsx`. Precondition: a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api PR #482 is the first repo — run locally via `npm run e2e:hermetic`, and note `seedPrIntent` returns early if a row already exists, so a DB seeded before the risk areas landed will not have them. LOCATOR CASING: the six label assertions here (INTENT, IN SCOPE, OUT OF SCOPE, RISK AREAS, CONFIDENCE, MISSING CONTEXT) are written in the RENDERED casing, not the casing of the source string or the message catalogue. `wait --text` matches the text as rendered, and `SectionLabel` plus this card's `columnHead`/`blockLabel`/`metaLabel` styles all set `text-transform: uppercase` — so asserting the catalogue's "Intent" times out against a card that is on screen and correct, which reads as a broken feature and is not one.
